user_query: I want to surprise my best friend with a personalized gift. Can you help me find some relevant images and suggest search queries related to gift ideas? Also, provide me with the supported languages and countries for search in the Bing Web Search tool.

TaskList.description: Gather suggestions for personalized gift ideas.
Generate relevant search queries based on the gift ideas gathered.
Use the Bing Web Search API to find relevant images using the generated search queries.
Retrieve information about supported languages and countries for the Bing Web Search tool.
